description: This header file defines constants and function prototypes related to prompting and reading input in a git-related context, including flags for prompt behavior and functions for prompting and reading lines interactively.

methods.name: git_prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user with the specified prompt string and flags, returning the user's input as a string.

methods.name: git_read_line_interactively
methods.description: Reads a line interactively from the user into the provided strbuf structure.
